summaries.summary: This slide from Nestlé's 2011 Full Year Results Roadshow (February 21st, 2012) presents a bar chart titled '10 years of the Nestlé Model: Driving Organic Growth & EBIT Margin Improvement,' showing annual organic growth and EBIT margin from 2001 to 2011. It also displays 10-year annual averages: Organic Growth at 6.4% and Real Internal Growth at 3.6%. The chart includes a line graph for EBIT margin, which shows a steady increase from 11.8% in 2001 to 15.0% in 2011, with a note that data corresponds to published figures not restated for accounting changes.
key_facts: EBIT margin increased from 11.8% in 2001 to 15.0% in 2011
